submission.justification: K1 has the best resolution (2.9%) but its intrinsic background of 2.0 counts/kg/day is 4 times the 0.5 budget, so it is unsuitable for low-background operation. K2 has the best resolution of the remaining candidates (4.5% vs 8.5% for K3) and meets the budget at 0.30 counts/kg/day. Thickness has a weak effect on resolution in the 3-8 cm range, so I chose the simulated 5 cm. I did not run a new thickness scan, so the 5 cm choice rests on the 2025 simulation only.

requirements.evidence: K2 gives 4.5% FWHM at 5 cm. This is the best of the candidates that pass the background constraint. K1 is better (2.9%) but fails the background constraint.
